scripts.visual: playwright install chromium && storybook build --quiet && playwright test
scripts.visual:update: playwright install chromium && storybook build --quiet && playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.test:a11y: playwright install chromium && storybook build --quiet && playwright test --config=playwright-a11y.config.ts
scripts.test:storybook: playwright install chromium && storybook build --quiet && playwright test --config=playwright-interactions.config.ts
